exposure: administration of antenatal late preterm steroids
Administration of antenatal late preterm steroids
cohort: 123 mother-neonate pairs where the mother had pre-gestational or gestational diabetes and was admitted between 34 0/7-36 6/7 weeks' gestation
finding: Neonates born to mothers with diabetes who received late preterm corticosteroids experienced greater odds of hypoglycemia in the first 24 hours of life.
